info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Airline Flights Cancel-v4-spec
info.description: The Cancel Airline Flights API allows users to effectively manage and cancel flight reservations within the airline system. This endpoint provides a streamlined process for consumers such as travel agencies and airline staff to ensure timely cancellation of bookings. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance their operational efficiency and improve customer service responses when travelers need to alter their plans. This feature is essential for maintaining accurate flight schedules and reservation systems.

delete.description: This operation allows users to cancel an existing flight booking. Upon cancellation, the user will receive a confirmation of the cancellation and any relevant details regarding refunds or penalties.

requestBody.description: This request body allows you to cancel a flight by providing the necessary information in JSON format. Ensure that you specify all required fields to successfully process the cancellation request.

200.description: The cancellation request was processed successfully.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling a flight operation via DELETE method.

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the cancellation operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the cancellation operation.

audit.description: Information about the audit trail of the cancellation operation.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.description: Response schema for the successful cancellation of a flight operation.

createdBy.description: The user who created the audit record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the audit record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing the audit information for a cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
